name: bolt-memory-analyzer
description: Instrument Bolt MemoryPool and analyze arbitrary trace ranges with Perfetto.

interface.shortDescription: Trace and diagnose Bolt memory behavior.
interface.longDescription: Install high-performance Bolt MemoryPool tracing, convert large captures to standard Perfetto traces, query them with native Trace Processor SQL, render interactive flame graphs for arbitrary timeline selections, and generate model-friendly peak, lifetime, leak, and churn findings.
defaultPrompt: Install Bolt memory tracing in this checkout.
Convert this Bolt memory trace to Perfetto and explain its peak.
Analyze this Bolt memory trace for leaks and retention.
